name: Vegetable Mandu
steps: Finely chop cabbage, salt lightly and squeeze out its moisture.
Crumble pressed tofu; grate carrot and chop spring onion and garlic. Mix all with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Place a tablespoon of filling in each wrapper. Moisten the rim with water, fold into a half-moon and pinch firmly, making pleats if desired.
Pan-fry in batches with a little neutral oil for 2 minutes until bottoms brown. Add a splash from the measured water, cover and steam 5 minutes until wrappers are cooked; uncover to crisp bottoms.
tips: Squeeze cabbage well so the sealed mandu do not leak while steaming.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
